svg.title: Match each sleep problem with the first measure the nurse should try.
svg.desc: Behavioral measures come first, and the American College of Physicians recommends cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia as the initial treatment for chronic insomnia in adults. Diphenhydramine is the trap because it is sold over the counter and sounds harmless. The AGS Beers Criteria say to avoid first-generation antihistamines in older adults because they are highly anticholinergic and raise the risk of confusion and falls, and benzodiazepines and the so-called Z-drugs carry the same warning. Noise, evening caffeine and long late naps are the modifiable causes in these four situations.
